description: M0 distribution support matrix (M0-E02-S05; DR-007 D2 = A, D3 = A). Authoritative for cloud-platform's capability checker, read at the pinned docs commit. A 'supported' verdict means matrix conformance only, never host qualification (qualification: none). Matching is an exact string match on os-release ID and VERSION_ID plus arch; ID_LIKE never confers support. support_ends is informative; the verdict never reads the clock. Erratum r2a (2026-10-06): evaluation order and positively established containment.

os_release.rule: os-release(5) strict parse; duplicate keys, invalid escapes, NUL/control characters, lines over 4096 bytes or non-UTF-8 -> unknown OSRELEASE_MALFORMED

arch.rule: pass iff equal to the entry arch (x86_64); other value -> fail; missing/unreadable -> unknown

cpu_virt.rule: pass iff a flags line contains vmx or svm; flags present without either -> fail; no flags line -> unknown

kernel_floor.rule: leading MAJOR.MINOR compared numerically with kernel_floor; unparseable -> unknown

cgroup_v2.rule: pass iff cgroup.controllers is a regular file and mountinfo has a cgroup2 mount at /sys/fs/cgroup; a non-cgroup2 mount there -> fail; unreadable -> unknown

systemd.rule: pass iff a directory; absent -> fail; unreadable -> unknown

nftables_kernel.rule: pass iff loaded (sys/module/nf_tables or proc/modules) or listed in modules.builtin or modules.dep for the root's kernel; otherwise unknown, never fail

lsm.rule: apparmor: pass iff enabled is Y and sys/kernel/security/lsm lists apparmor; N, or module absent -> fail; either unreadable -> unknown. selinux (planned entries only): pass iff enforce is 1, else fail. Never remediated by disabling, permissive or complain mode

containment.rule: evaluated first. Any container marker -> unknown CONTAINERIZED (verdict unknown). Hypervisor guest marker -> fail VIRTUALIZED_HOST (verdict unsupported). pass only when every container source is readable (or a marker file provably absent) and shows no marker and no guest marker; otherwise unknown CONTAINMENT_UNDETERMINED (non-root --root / on a real host is therefore unknown)
